verdict.rationale: OpenHands has no documented region picker for its managed Cloud. Users can still control where data lives by running the open-source agent locally, in Docker, on VMs, or on any backend they operate, and Enterprise offers licensed self-hosting. This is residency control through self-hosting rather than a selectable data-residency option. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for OpenHands Cloud, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration.
